DROP PROCEDURE [EDS].[SP_CUSTOMER_TRB_DETAIL]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROC [EDS].[SP_CUSTOMER_TRB_DETAIL] AS
BEGIN

DELETE FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_TRB_DETAIL;

INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_TRB_DETAIL
(
AS_OF_DATE
,GAM_BANK_ID
,REGION
,AREA
,BRANCH_NAME
,GAM_ACID
,FORACID
,ORGKEY
,ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
)

SELECT EDA.AS_OF_DATE
	, EDF.GAM_BANK_ID	
	, EBD.REGION AS REGION
	, EBD.AREA AS AREA
	, EBD.SOL_DESC AS BRANCH_NAME
	, EDF.GAM_ACID	
	, EDF.FORACID
	, ECD.ORGKEY 
	, EDF.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE 
	, EDP.PRODUCT_GROUP
	, EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE	
	, EDF_MTD.CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP 
	, EDF_MTD.YTD_BALANCE_PHP YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP	
FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA

JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
	ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
	AND EDA.BNK_CODE = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
	AND SUBSTRING(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
	AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
	AND 
		(
			EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' 
			OR (EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NULL AND EDF.ACCT_OPN_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE)
		)


LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_UAT EDF_MTD
--JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_uat EDF_MTD
	ON EDA.ACID = EDF_MTD.GAM_ACID
	AND EDA.BNK_CODE = EDF_MTD.GAM_BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF_MTD.FULLDATE


LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
--JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
	AND EDA.BNK_CODE = ECD.BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
	
--LEFT JOIN EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING EDP	
LEFT JOIN EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING EDP
	ON EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE = EDP.PRODUCT_TYPE
	AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDP.BANK_CODE
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EDP.SCD_START_DATE AND EDP.SCD_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM EBD
--JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM EBD
    ON EDF.SOL_ID = EBD.SOL_ID
    AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EBD.BANK_ID
    AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBD.SCD_START_DATE AND EBD.SCD_END_DATE
			
WHERE EDA.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
	AND EDA.DEL_FLG = 'N'
	AND (
			EDA.AS_OF_DATE = (
								SELECT MIN(BUSINESS_DATE) AS BUSINESS_DATE
								FROM (
										SELECT DEPOSITS_DATE AS BUSINESS_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
										UNION
										SELECT LOANS_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
										UNION
										SELECT CCD_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
										UNION
										SELECT TRU_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
										UNION
										SELECT TRY_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
									) TMP
							)
			OR EDA.AS_OF_DATE IN (
									SELECT FULLDATE 
									FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
									WHERE FULLDATE BETWEEN DATEADD (month , -13 , CAST(SYSDATETIME () AS DATE) ) 
										AND CAST(SYSDATETIME () AS DATE) 
										AND MONTH_END = 'Y'
								)
		);
END
GO
